title: A die constrained by its mean
hook: Two stated cases: explore the mean constraint in an exponential maximum-entropy family.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the mean constraint in an exponential maximum-entropy family affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Tilt, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the mean constraint in an exponential maximum-entropy family in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: On toy faces 1 through 6, use maximum-entropy probabilities proportional to exp(tilt×face), constrained to mean 4.5. What tilt solves the mean by bisection on [-10,10]?
